Lead physical action with the person doing it; use their possessive for a body part or worn item and clear pronouns afterward. Carry an object from an adjacent scene only when the current scene explicitly does so. Before returning, read the shot by itself: every action has an actor, every item has a clear owner or placement, and the camera movement fits the same physical action. Resolve uncertainty with clear verbs and possessives, not explanatory qualifiers. Return only the requested shot JSON with natural visual prose.
